solution_files.two-fer.lisp:
;; Two-fer, written with different names, layout and comments.
(DEFPACKAGE #:two-fer
  (:EXPORT #:two-for-one)
  (:USE :COMMON-LISP))

(IN-PACKAGE #:TWO-FER)

(defun Two-For-One (&optional (person nil))
  "Says who the cookie is for."
  (cl:format nil "One for ~a, one for me." (or person "you")))

exercise_files.two-fer-test.lisp:
(defpackage :two-fer-test
  (:use :cl :two-fer :lisp-unit))
(in-package :two-fer-test)
(define-test two-fer (assert-equal "One for you, one for me." (two-fer:two-for-one)))
